"''Skirmishes don't win wars lieutenant, vengeance does.|[[Lieutenant]] [[Kith Alaytia]] and [[Moff]] [[Ubrik Adelhard]]|}} Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Moff]] [[Ubrik Adelhard]], commanding his [[flagship]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Scepter (Imperial-class)|Scepter]]'', engaged in a '''skirmish''' with [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Rebel Alliance Navy forces]] that had entered the [[Anoat sector]]. After managing to disable the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starfighter]]s, the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial naval forces]], on the order of Adelhard, destroyed all rebel [[starship]]s, leaving no survivors. {{Battle-stub}} ==Appearances== *[[Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising 1|''Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising'' 1]] {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Anoat sector, skirmish in the}} [[Category:Battles in the Anoat sector]] [[Category:Battles of the Iron Blockade]]
